_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_PM).

levels.name: Ground level: station building (Asemakatu 2, built 1981) and the platforms: edge platform 1 (station side), island platform 3/4, platform 6 (east)
levels.name_source: Väylävirasto, "Ratapihaselvitykset: Pieksämäki" (Väyläviraston julkaisuja 58/2026, published 2026-08-10, CC BY 4.0), pp. 17–18, 25–27, 35, https://www.doria.fi/bitstream/10024/195303/1/vj_2026-58_978-952-405-444-7.pdf, read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit (Väylävirasto / Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0) via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-PM/_report.json and pieksamaki_platform_vayla.geojson, read 2026-10-30; https://www.vr.fi/rautatieasemat-ja-reitit/pieksamaki, read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pieks%C3%A4m%C3%A4ki_railway_station, read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Asematunneli (pedestrian tunnel under the tracks)
levels.name_source: Pieksämäen kaupunki / WSP, "Pieksämäen aseman alueen kehittämissuunnitelma" (19.2.2020), https://www.pieksamaki.fi/wp-content/uploads/Pieks%C3%A4m%C3%A4en-aseman-alueen-kehitt%C3%A4missuunnitelma.pdf, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-PM.json), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_PM).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 2 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_PM).

1._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.3182770, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 1, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 210 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

structures.name: roof
structures._source: Outline OSM w155336251 (ODbL); roof = median of 11 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_N5211C1), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned N5211C1 2025-06-14 (20250002_MML_Pieksamaki_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_PM/pieksamaki_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 122.32 m RH 2000, laser 2025-06-14); underside not measured

structures.name: bridge
structures._source: Outline OSM w1230324174 (ODbL); roof = median of 14 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_N5211C1), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned N5211C1 2025-06-14 (20250002_MML_Pieksamaki_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_PM/pieksamaki_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 122.32 m RH 2000, laser 2025-06-14); underside drawn at the minimum clear height over an electrified railway, 5.9 m above the rail (TRVR Bro 11, Trafikverket publ. 2011:086): a lower bound, not measured

terrain._source: ground from the laser's ground points, 1 m (data/stations/research/fi_PM/pieksamaki_ground_1m.tif), sampled every 5 m; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0. Heights above the platform surface (122.32 m N2000, laser 2025-06-14)
